discourse.title: Love Is The Royal Road To Reach God
discourse.excerpt: You should love all and serve all. Love is present not only in human beings, but also in birds and animals. All can experience love including birds, animals, and insects. Whomsoever you see, there is God in them in the form of Atma. If you hate someone, it amounts to hating God. Therefore, do not hate anyone. Do not be angry with anyone.
discourse.theme: Love is the royal road to God — love all, serve all.

reflection: Swami makes an astonishing claim: if you hate anyone, you are hating God — because the same Atma shines in them as in you. So the question He puts to you is direct: whom have you been angry with? Drop it. Love is the royal road, not a side path. Love all, serve all — start with one person you have been avoiding, and serve them something small today. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 42, 29 Oct 2009)
